tailoring.headline: Technical Product Manager | SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: Technical Product Manager and backend developer with 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and workflow automation. Proven expertise in requirements engineering, stakeholder management, process mapping, and PIM/ERP integrations. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Technical Product Manager
cover_en.hook: I am thrilled to apply for the Technical Product Manager position at Iksula. With over five years of hands-on experience engineering large-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical backend expertise with rigorous techno-functional product delivery.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Workflow Management
bullets.text: Architected and delivered complex backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), covering product catalogs, pricing, and automated workflow data processes using Java and Spring.

bullets.label: Requirements & Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical domains by gathering business requirements, writing user stories, mapping processes, and translating stakeholder needs into robust e-commerce solutions.

bullets.label: API & System Integration
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST APIs and built automated PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure seamless omni-channel platform synchronization.

bullets.label: Agile & Cross-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with international technical teams, product owners, and business stakeholders across agile delivery lifecycles, performing code reviews and guiding technical execution.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce and product delivery experience aligns with Iksula's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to join Iksula as a Technical Product Manager to drive high-impact e-commerce platforms. My 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud delivery, combined with strong techno-functional requirements engineering and workflow integration experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, position me to bridge business vision and technical execution effectively for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud engineering and techno-functional product analysis to drive scalable e-commerce solutions and seamless workflow automation at Iksula.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I applied for the Technical Product Manager role at Iksula. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience and a strong techno-functional background bridging business and IT, I bring proven expertise in platform architecture and integrations. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Technical Product Manager - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Technical Product Manager position at Iksula.

With over five years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise spanning requirements engineering, workflow automation, API integrations, and agile cross-functional delivery.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
